en.headline: Hong Kong schools weigh Paris iGEM trip amid France travel alert
en.dek: More than 30 schools and nearly 600 students and teachers had planned to attend the synthetic-biology competition next month; the Education Bureau says safety is the priority.
body: Several Hong Kong secondary schools and universities are reassessing plans to send teams to the iGEM synthetic-biology competition in Paris next month after the government issued an amber outbound travel alert for France.
More than 30 secondary schools and universities involving nearly 600 students and teachers had been scheduled to travel to Paris for the event from 13 to 16 November.

The Education Bureau said schools had been repeatedly reminded that the safety and well-being of participants must be the primary consideration when organising overseas study activities. It urged schools to make appropriate adjustments according to the situation at the destination and to stay in close contact with relevant parties.

United Christian College (Kowloon East) had planned to send nine students and one teacher on 10 November. Principal Samuel Cheng Kin-tak said the school was continuing to assess the situation with teachers and parents and did not need to decide immediately.

Cheng said the school would also seek further information from the organisers, its travel agency and its insurer. He noted that students would likely be disappointed if the trip were cancelled after months of preparation, but stressed that safety remained the overriding concern.
The bureau said it would remain in contact with the schools concerned and provide support where necessary.

zh.headline: 港校評估巴黎iGEM行程 教育局強調學生安全優先
zh.dek: 逾30間中學及大學、近600名師生原定下月赴巴黎參賽，政府已對法國發出黃色外遊警示，校方正重新評估。
body: 本港多間中學及大學正重新評估下月前往巴黎參加國際遺傳工程機器設計競賽（iGEM）的安排，因政府早前對法國發出黃色外遊警示。
原定有超過30間中學及大學、近600名師生，計劃於11月13日至16日前往巴黎參賽。
教育局表示，已多次提醒學校籌辦海外考察時，必須以參加者安全及福祉為首要考慮，並應按目的地情況作出適當調整，同時與相關持份者保持溝通。
滙基書院（東九龍）原定派出9名學生及1名教師於11月10日出發。校長鄭建德表示，校方正與教師及家長繼續評估情況，無需即時決定。
鄭建德指出，校方亦會向主辦單位、旅行社及保險公司查詢更多資訊。他承認若最終取消行程，學生或會失望，因他們已花多個月準備，但安全始終是首要考慮。
教育局表示會與有關學校保持緊密聯繫，並在有需要時提供支援。
